sources.title: Echo-𝛼: Large Agentic Multimodal Reasoning Model for Ultrasound ...
sources.snippet: We introduced Echo- α $α$, an agentic multimodal framework that unifies detector-level precision with MLLM-based reasoning for ultrasound interpretation. Its central idea is simple but effective: rather than treating detector outputs as final predictions, Echo- α $α$ treats them as callable evidence inside a learnable invoke-and-reason loop.
